display.name: MACD Zero-Cross
display.description:
macd(12,26,9) on 15m. histogram above zero we carry a long, below zero we flip short. that's the entry and the exit — the opposite cross is the stop.

around that we keep quoting both sides, so most of the pnl is spread and the signal decides which side we'd rather be filled on.

we post about half of what you do as first loss. 12-hour queue trigger: if withdrawals stop being serviced for half a day you can force an exit yourself.
